text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that standing be prohibited at all times on the west side of Westmount Avenue, between a point 31.2 metres north of Rogers Road and a point 9.8 metres further north. This is in response to multiple instances where a parked vehicle would partially block the driveway access at 416 and 402 Westmount Avenue. This proposal will improve driveway access at these premises and will not result in the loss of any parking spaces on Westmount Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the west side of Westmount Avenue, between a point 31.2 metres north of Rogers Road and a point 9.8 metres further north.
